baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence مَنَٰفِعُ إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ثُمَّ مَحِلُّهَا إِلَى ٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْعَتِيقِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Usable value is granted for a bounded, publicly designated interval; ثُمَّ closes that tenure, and مَحِلُّهَا combines arrival at a place with the falling-due of an obligation. The enduring House receives what can no longer remain merely available for use.

activation_trace.role: The harm-opposed benefit image establishes usable value as the first phase.
The fixed temporal limit makes that usefulness a tenure rather than an unrestricted possession.
Naming as designation makes the limit identifiable and authorized.
Arrival and settling at a place supplies the spatial side of the terminal transition.
The coming-due of a right or offering supplies the obligatory side of the same transition.
The shelter or dwelling image turns the destination into a receiving center.
Deep temporal rootedness distinguishes the receiving House from the temporary utility phase.

changed_reading.before: The objects are useful for a while and later go to a venerable house.
changed_reading.after: The ayah regulates a two-stage tenure: benefit remains available only until a named deadline, when settlement and due-ness transfer the object to the enduring House.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coupling of أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى with مَحِلُّهَا إِلَى ٱلْبَيْتِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The packet's alternate و س م inventory lets مُّسَمًّى activate a marked season at which people gather. On this reading the limit is not an abstract date but a socially legible season that collects dispersed benefits and directs them toward one House.

activation_trace.role: Benefit supplies the dispersed utilities that the marked season coordinates.
A fixed limit gives the assembly a bounded temporal station.
The marked season and gathering image turns the appointed term into a public rendezvous.
Settling at a place converts temporal convergence into spatial convergence.
The House is the common receiving shelter around which the season gathers.

changed_reading.before: مُّسَمًّى merely says that the deadline has a specified date.
changed_reading.after: The deadline can also be heard as a marked public season that gathers separate uses and users into a common arrival at the House.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The turn from مَنَٰفِعُ to مَحِلُّهَا and the qualification ٱلْعَتِيقِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The useful object first sits inside human instrumentality. At the term, the حل images of untying and release from restriction join the عتق image of emancipation, so the endpoint is a release from being held indefinitely as an asset.

activation_trace.role: Benefit names the object's initial availability to human use.
The time limit prevents that availability from becoming permanent.
Untying a knot supplies the image of release from the utility phase.
Release from a restriction supplies the legal change accompanying the physical release.
Emancipation makes the House an endpoint characterized by freedom from ownership.
The shelter image gives the released object a positive destination rather than mere disposal.

changed_reading.before: The endpoint simply terminates a period of practical use.
changed_reading.after: The endpoint releases the object from indefinite instrumentality and delivers it into the freedom-associated shelter of the House.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact temporal construction in 22:5 sits inside a process of holding in wombs, reaching the appointed term, emerging, and attaining maturity. That sequence revises the focus deadline from passive waiting into protected custody ordered toward a due emergence and destination.

activation_trace.role: The focus's fixed limit is the temporal hinge being revised.
The focus arrival supplies the post-custody destination.
Fixing and stabilizing supplies the protected holding phase before the deadline.
The female womb gives that holding phase a concrete developmental container.
The same fixed temporal limit links the developmental sequence directly to the focus wording.
The same designation image marks the developmental threshold as an appointed one.
Passage to the outside supplies the directional arrow after the appointed holding period.
Reaching a goal makes emergence part of an ordered maturation rather than an arbitrary cutoff.

structural_cues: 22:5 places إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ثُمَّ between stabilization in wombs and being brought out.
Both 22:5 and 22:33 use the named term as a hinge in a staged process.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a shared construction plus custody, emergence, and maturation; I transfer that process-shape to the focus objects. The live alternative is that the repeated phrase contributes only a generic deadline, not a developmental analogy.

changed_reading.before: The named term is merely the last day on which benefits may be taken.
changed_reading.after: The term is a guarded maturation threshold: benefits occur inside a temporary custody whose proper completion is release into the appointed destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: In 22:12-13 benefit is not self-authenticating: it is tested against harm and against the nearness of the relation producing it. This makes the focus's benefits ethically relational; their term and destination keep utility from becoming an ultimate allegiance.

activation_trace.role: The focus's harm-opposed benefit is the anchor whose value is being tested.
Negated benefit shows that a claimed object of reliance may fail the utility test.
Harm as benefit's contrary makes utility an explicit discriminating axis.
The repeated contrary becomes relationally dominant rather than merely possible.
Nearness ranks competing outcomes and makes benefit depend on the relation one approaches.
Benefit reappears as the subordinated side of that comparison.

structural_cues: 22:12 coordinates what neither harms nor benefits; 22:13 then says harm is nearer than benefit.
The focus immediately binds its benefits to a limit and a House-directed endpoint.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit benefit-harm-nearness test; I infer that the focus's utility is legitimate because it remains subordinate to its named destination. The alternative is a strictly material sense with no carryover from the earlier polemic.

changed_reading.before: مَنَٰفِعُ is a neutral inventory of practical gains.
changed_reading.after: The benefits are relationally judged goods: valid utility is utility that does not replace the orientation toward its due destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: The local sequence makes the House equally available to resident and visitor, sends travelers toward it, has them witness benefits, feeds the needy, completes vows, and culminates in circumambulation. The focus therefore compresses a circulation system: benefits are witnessed and redistributed before the common House coordinates completion.

activation_trace.role: The focus benefit anchors the material that circulates through the sequence.
The receiving shelter anchors the common center of circulation.
The time-rooted House supplies continuity across repeated public arrivals.
Equality between two parties makes access to the center nonexclusive.
The repeated House as shelter ties prepared place and receiving center together.
Presence with direct witnessing makes benefits public events rather than private abstractions.
The exact benefit root links the witnessed gains to the focus.
Feeding another converts benefit into outward distribution.
Need and lack identify a recipient for the distributed benefit.
Completion without deficiency makes fulfillment part of the terminal phase.
Circling around a center makes the House an active organizer of motion.
The same shelter image identifies the center around which completion moves.
The repeated ancientness confirms that this is the focus's named destination.

structural_cues: 22:25 declares the sanctuary equal for resident and visitor.
22:27-29 moves from arrival, to witnessed benefits and feeding, to fulfillment and circumambulation.
22:28, 22:29, and 22:33 repeat the focus roots for benefits and the Ancient House.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies equal access, incoming movement, witnessed benefit, feeding, fulfillment, and circling; I connect them as one circulation mechanism summarized by 22:33. The alternative is that these are adjacent but independent pilgrimage acts.

changed_reading.before: The benefits belong primarily to the immediate owners until an endpoint at the House.
changed_reading.after: The benefits participate in a public circuit of witnessing, nourishment, fulfillment, and equal access whose coordinating center is the Ancient House.

context_deltas.mechanism: 22:30 places the making-lawful of livestock inside a sentence about magnifying inviolable limits and preserving exceptions. This activates the legal-state branch of مَحِلُّهَا: benefits are licensed uses, not proof of unrestricted ownership, and the deadline moves the livestock into its due disposition.

activation_trace.role: The focus benefit is recast as a permitted use rather than an absolute title.
Release from prohibition supplies the legal-state dimension of the focus endpoint.
The falling-due of a right makes legal availability terminate in obligation.
Inviolability and protected right bound the surrounding grant of use.
The explicit release from prohibition identifies livestock utility as legally granted.
The livestock-wealth image identifies the material class whose lawful use is bounded.

structural_cues: 22:30 joins magnifying inviolable limits, livestock made lawful, explicit exceptions, and commands of avoidance.
22:33 gives benefits a temporal limit before مَحِلُّهَا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lawful livestock within protected limits; I infer that the focus's utility is a revocable legal permission that matures into a due claim. The alternative is that حلال in 22:30 and محل in 22:33 remain semantically separate.

changed_reading.before: Having benefits implies broad control over the useful animals until sacrifice.
changed_reading.after: The benefits are a bounded license inside an inviolable order; usefulness never cancels the due claim that takes effect at the term.

context_deltas.mechanism: 22:31 depicts uncontrolled motion: falling, being snatched, being driven by wind, and ending in a remote place. Against that sequence, the focus's named term and repeated إِلَى create a controlled vector whose stable terminus is the House.

activation_trace.role: Settling at a place anchors controlled arrival.
A shelter supplies the stable terminus opposed to dispersal.
Temporal rootedness makes the destination durable rather than accidental.
Noisy, unstable falling supplies the first form of unguided motion.
Rapid seizure interrupts agency and fractures the trajectory.
Falling into an abyss extends the image of destination without orientation.
Wind supplies the external force that carries the fallen object away.
Extreme distance supplies the anti-destination against which the House stands.

structural_cues: 22:31 ends with uncontrolled movement into مَكَانٍ سَحِيقٍ.
22:33 instead uses a named interval, ثُمَّ, and إِلَى twice before naming the House.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two adjacent motion grammars; I read the second as a stabilizing reversal of the first. The alternative is that 22:31's fall concerns only belief and has no spatial activation for 22:33.

changed_reading.before: The House is simply the stated endpoint of a ritual itinerary.
changed_reading.after: The House is the anti-scatter terminus: named timing and due settlement rescue motion from seizure, drift, and remote dissipation.

context_deltas.mechanism: 22:32 identifies the relevant signs as marks whose magnification arises from protective piety in the heart; 22:36 then identifies the sacrificial bodies themselves among those signs. The focus benefits therefore occur inside a sign-bearing trust: utility must preserve, not consume, the object's capacity to complete its marked rite.

activation_trace.role: Practical benefit is the use that must be subordinated to sign-bearing stewardship.
A visible identifying mark makes the appointed threshold part of the sign mechanism.
A marking sign and ritual token gives the useful object a representational status beyond utility.
Protection from harm turns reverence into active custodial restraint.
The inner core locates the motive that governs outward handling.
The dedicated sacrificial body identifies the concrete bearer of the sign.
The repeated ritual-sign image explicitly places that body in the marked category.

structural_cues: 22:32 locates magnification of the signs in the piety of hearts.
22:36 calls the sacrificial bodies signs and again says they contain good for the addressees.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies useful bodies that are also ritual signs; I infer a stewardship rule in which permissible benefit cannot erase their terminal sign-function. The alternative is that sign-reverence and economic use coexist without one constraining the other.

changed_reading.before: The animals first supply benefits and only later acquire ritual significance.
changed_reading.after: They remain sign-bearing trusts throughout the benefit phase, so the deadline protects their capacity to reach the rite for which they are marked.

context_deltas.mechanism: 22:34 names a sacrificial rite; 22:36 then stages the bodies until their sides fall, after which eating and feeding begin; 22:37 denies that flesh or blood reaches God and makes piety the true reaching element. This activates مَحِلُّهَا as a due event that converts privately usable life into shared provision and moral reach.

activation_trace.role: The focus benefit supplies the pre-terminal use phase.
The coming-due of an offering supplies the focus hinge into terminal disposition.
The sacrificial offering identifies the type of due event being staged.
Falling and coming to rest gives the due event a visible bodily threshold.
Fixity and obligation resonate with the focus branch of a right becoming due.
Feeding others converts the completed body into outwardly shared benefit.
Contentment identifies one social posture among the recipients.
Presenting oneself or coming to seek identifies another route by which benefit reaches recipients.
Being made tractable for a purpose frames the whole utility-to-rite process as directed service.
The paired delivery image distinguishes what does not reach God materially from what reaches morally.
Literal flesh supplies one material whose divine delivery is explicitly denied.
Literal blood supplies the second material whose divine delivery is explicitly denied.
Protective piety names the nonmaterial result that truly reaches.

structural_cues: 22:34 assigns a sacrificial rite over provision from livestock.
22:36 repeats a benefit formula, then uses فَإِذَا وَجَبَتْ جُنُوبُهَا as the threshold for eating and feeding.
22:37 reverses the apparent direction of delivery: flesh and blood do not reach God, but piety does.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a rite, a bodily fall, distribution, and a corrected reach relation; I align the focus's حلول الوجوب branch with that threshold and treat the House as the institutional endpoint of conversion. The alternative is that مَحِلُّهَا denotes only slaughter location.

changed_reading.before: At the deadline the useful animal is delivered as material to the House.
changed_reading.after: At the due event, utility changes form: the body falls into shared nourishment, while the offering's Godward reach lies in piety rather than transferred flesh or blood.

context_deltas.mechanism: 22:40 links expulsion from homes to a counterforce that prevents worship buildings from being demolished. This activates the freedom branch of عَتِيقِ and the shelter branch of بَيْت: the destination is a protected common refuge whose freedom must be maintained against exclusion and destruction.

activation_trace.role: The shelter image anchors the House as refuge.
Emancipation supplies the House's freedom from coercive possession.
Forced passage outside supplies the social wound that a protected refuge reverses.
Belonging to a dwelling makes the expulsion specifically a loss of settled home.
Driving away harm supplies the protective counterforce that keeps worship space open.
The collapse of buildings names the material threat from which sacred shelters require defense.
Places of worship broaden the protected-House mechanism beyond private residence.

structural_cues: 22:40 moves from people expelled from their dwellings to the threatened demolition of multiple worship structures.
The focus calls its receiving shelter عَتِيق, whose inventory includes freedom from bondage.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies displacement, defended access, and worship buildings; I infer that the focus's freedom-qualified House is a paradigmatic protected refuge. The alternative is that 22:40 states a general defense principle without modifying عَتِيق.

changed_reading.before: The Ancient House is old, noble, and ritually central.
changed_reading.after: The Free House is also an anti-displacement refuge: its ritual centrality depends on defended access and freedom from coercive capture.

context_deltas.mechanism: 22:47 opposes human hastening and counting to a promise that does not miss its appointment; 22:48 gives delay a ثُمَّ and an eventual destination; 22:76 closes with all matters returned. The focus deadline is therefore firm but not owner-controlled, and its local Houseward arrival can echo a larger grammar of return without being equated with it.

activation_trace.role: The fixed limit anchors the question of certainty and temporal scale.
Coming due supplies the event whose timing cannot be forced by beneficiaries.
Hastening and bringing forward supplies the human attempt to control the deadline.
A promise failing at its appointed time is explicitly negated, making due time reliable.
A promise bounded by time or place gives the deadline covenantal force.
A span of time whose scale shifts destabilizes purely human measurement.
Counting supplies the human metric that the verse relativizes.
Extended time and respite supplies a long benefit-like interval before reckoning.
Becoming toward an ultimate outcome echoes the focus's directional terminal clause.
Return to what matters came from supplies the surah-wide completion of the destination grammar.

structural_cues: 22:47 says the promise will not fail while contrasting a divine day with human counting.
22:48 has respite, then seizure, then إِلَىَّ ٱلْمَصِيرُ.
22:76 ends with وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reliable appointment, divergent temporal scale, delay-then-destination, and return; I let that grammar deepen the focus deadline while keeping the House endpoint local. The live alternative is that the eschatological timing passages should not color the ritual schedule.

changed_reading.before: The appointed term is a calendar date managed by the human beneficiaries.
changed_reading.after: The term is certain yet not theirs to accelerate or redefine; the local due arrival rehearses a wider pattern in which respite closes in an assured return.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah, the appointed term is named, God's name is voiced over provision, and the selected community is itself named and made witness. This changes مُّسَمًّى from a bare calendar label into one link in a public authorization chain joining time, offering, and accountable people.

activation_trace.role: Naming and designation anchor the focus term in the authorization chain.
Voicing remembrance on the tongue makes authorization audible in the rite.
The divine name is attached to the provision whose benefits the focus regulates.
Repeated naming joins the assigned rite to its authorizing name.
Naming over the sacrificial bodies marks their terminal handling as accountable action.
Selection and drawing near supplies the authorization of the human participants.
The community's explicit naming mirrors the focus term's designation.
Knowledgeable testimony assigns public accountability to the named community.

structural_cues: 22:28, 22:34, and 22:36 repeat God's name over provision and sacrificial bodies.
22:78 says the community was named and then assigns reciprocal witness roles.
The focus itself qualifies the term as مُّسَمًّى.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated acts of naming over term, offering, and community; I infer a chain of authorization rather than mere lexical recurrence. The alternative is that اسم and مسمى perform unrelated grammatical jobs and should not be mechanistically joined.

changed_reading.before: The term is named only so participants can know when use ends.
changed_reading.after: The named term belongs to a wider regime of designation: time, offering, and witnesses are made publicly accountable under the name invoked over them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the packet's water-basin branch for أَجَل is form-distant from the ordinary temporal construction. It remains anchored in the focus's أَجَل and becomes materially coherent beside the surah's water-to-growth sequences. Downstream prose should present it only as a reservoir analogy for custody and release, never as a replacement lexical gloss for 'appointed term.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَجَلٍ at focus word 5, especially its packet branch of a basin that gathers water and then releases it to crops.

activation_trace.role: Benefit supplies what is accumulated and later released in changed form.
A basin gathering water before sending it to crops supplies the reservoir mechanism.
Water delivered by pouring supplies the released material.
Vegetation emerging from earth supplies the fructifying result of release.
Causing something to descend and arrive supplies the controlled input to the reservoir analogy.
Delivered water repeats the material that changes latent capacity into visible benefit.
Fresh green growth supplies the visible payoff of timed release.

changed_reading.before: The term is only a line on a calendar after which benefits stop.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the term behaves like a reservoir: it holds a field of benefit in custody until release redirects that stored usefulness into ritual and social fruit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because مَحِلّ is normally read through ح ل ل, while the packet also preserves a non-dominant ح ل ي mapping whose adornment branch is activated in 22:23. The reading remains packet-anchored at the focus word and yields a coherent transformation from utility into ritual beautification. It should be rendered as branch-induced wordplay or resonance, not as the lexical translation of مَحِلُّهَا.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مَحِلُّهَا at focus word 8 through the packet-supplied alternate mapped root root_000353.

activation_trace.role: Adornment and ornament supply an alternate transformational resonance for the focus endpoint.
Being adorned makes the branch image explicit elsewhere in the surah and activates the non-dominant focus mapping.
The House gives the proposed adornment a ritual center rather than a decorative end in itself.

changed_reading.before: The terminal phase merely relocates the useful object.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory resonance, arrival at the House converts bare utility into an adornment of the rite: usefulness is not destroyed but recoded as fitting beauty around the sacred center.

strongest_changes: The exact 22:5 construction turned the named deadline into a custody-maturation-release threshold.
The 22:25-29 sequence turned private benefit into witnessed, equal-access circulation and nourishment.
The falling and feeding sequence of 22:36, corrected by the reach contrast in 22:37, turned مَحِلُّهَا into a due event that converts use into distribution and piety.
The time and return grammar of 22:47-48 and 22:76 made the deadline certain but not beneficiary-controlled.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah became a compact switching mechanism rather than a static rule: temporary utility is held, marked, legally bounded, and then transformed at a protected House-centered threshold. The packet's split mappings also exposed live seasonal, emancipatory, reservoir, and adornment resonances without forcing them into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact referent scope of فِيهَا and مَحِلُّهَا may be the sacrificial bodies specifically or the broader sign-complex.
مَحِلُّهَا can sustain both place-of-arrival and event-of-obligation; the context strengthens both without fully selecting one.
The و س م seasonal reading and ح ل ي adornment reading depend on non-dominant packet mappings and should remain explicitly exploratory.
The eschatological destination echoes may deepen the ritual itinerary without making the House endpoint identical to final return.
